summary: Phase 8A completed the product route decision and app MVP planning boundary for the future user app. The selected route is React Web / PWA MVP first, with Makeup Engine remaining the template production system and UserAppTemplatePackage remaining the handoff contract. No production app, backend, database, camera, AR, training, OpenAI API, external API, native iOS, React Native, Flutter, ecommerce, community, paid features, analytics, accounts, online publication, app store release work, or separate repository bootstrap was added.

routeDecision.futureAppOwnership: separate user-facing app surface/repository after a future explicit phase gate
routeDecision.makeupEngineOwnership: template production, package export, local contract prototype, and QA evidence only
deferredRoutes: ecommerce, community, paid features, analytics, app store release, and model training

nextAction: Proceed to Phase 8B: PWA / Mobile Web MVP Polish. Polish the mobile-first React Web / PWA MVP brief, UX acceptance criteria, package consumption expectations, and trial-readiness checklist. Do not expand legacy frozen modules
